features.name: Core Platform Security
features.description: Console setup, authentication, CSRF, secret encryption, safe error boundaries, Gateway readiness, configuration reload, and graceful shutdown protect the core platform.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/console-request-security-contract.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-secure-bootstrap.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-lifecycle-drain.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/console-request-security-contract.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-secure-bootstrap.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/runtime-observability-removal.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: Security/lifecycle unit tests and all five real-process E2E pass. Process-heavy Console E2E run serially to avoid competing Next dev instances.

features.name: Provider Model Management
features.description: Provider credentials, OAuth, connectivity, model discovery, capability synchronization, manual overrides, dependency guards, and price synchronization remain supported.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/provider-model-capability-sync.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-provider-dependency-guard.unit.test.ts tests/features/provider-authenticated-http-safety.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/provider-model-capability-sync.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-provider-dependency-guard.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/provider-authenticated-http-safety.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: Provider/model sync preserves Provider API > models.dev > OpenRouter > LiteLLM > Vercel priority, removes conflict-to-unknown calculation, and a successful connectivity probe restores both Provider and selected-model health. Focused unit and database E2E coverage pass.

features.name: Virtual Model Routing
features.description: Virtual Models enforce one complete six-field capability contract and route with fixed, cost_first, or random ordering, health filtering, and fallback.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/virtual-model-capability-contract.unit.test.ts tests/features/virtual-model-endpoint-routing.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-fallback-health.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/virtual-model-capability-contract.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/virtual-model-endpoint-routing.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-fallback-health.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-12: Capability consistency, endpoint protocol selection, health filtering, and fallback behavior pass. Virtual Model deletion now blocks only Agent defaults/grants and transactionally retires the Virtual Model's owned Route Policy. Real Console E2E verifies route-owned deletion and inline duplicate-name errors.

features.name: Gateway Protocol Execution
features.description: Gateway executes Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and Embeddings with provider header/body transparency, streaming safety, and metadata-only logs.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/gateway-request-hygiene.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-error-fidelity.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-metadata-only-logging.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/v1-gateway-routing.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-request-hygiene.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-error-fidelity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-metadata-only-logging.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: All four public protocols, streaming/error fidelity, request-metadata-only logs, and provider smoke E2E pass. Responses requires canonical list input and performs no Codex parameter rewriting or SSE-to-JSON bridging. Gateway strips browser transport headers before Provider dispatch, Provider failures log their complete upstream response, and Claude Code Messages retains its required Agent SDK identity and Subscription headers.

features.name: Agent Access And Limits
features.description: Agent API keys, Virtual Model grants, RPM, TPM, token, budget, and concurrency limits are enforced without non-core Agent modes or logging switches.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/gateway-settlement-integrity.unit.test.ts tests/features/refactor-agent-limit-domain-types.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/gateway-settlement-integrity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/v1-console.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: Agent authentication, grants, limit enforcement, settlement, and stale concurrency repair pass.

features.name: Usage And Activity
features.description: Activity, token usage, latency, failure rate, fallback, Provider health, and actual or estimated request cost are recorded and reported without savings baselines.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/gateway-recording-resilience.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-settlement-integrity.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/gateway-recording-resilience.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-settlement-integrity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/schema-fallback-single-source.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: Core request recording, usage/cost settlement, fallback history, and resilience checks pass.

features.name: Worker Model Operations
features.description: Worker persists only model refresh, Provider connectivity, and price sync jobs; retention and stale concurrency maintenance run directly under advisory locks.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/worker-job-churn-removal.unit.test.ts tests/features/v1-worker-ops.unit.test.ts tests/features/worker-lease-recovery.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/worker-job-churn-removal.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/v1-worker-ops.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/worker-lease-recovery.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: Core leased jobs, fencing/recovery, advisory-lock maintenance, retention, and zero maintenance-job churn pass.

features.name: Console Core
features.description: Console exposes Overview, Agents, Providers, Virtual Models, Activity, Usage, Limits, and Playground with the reduced core navigation and forms.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/core-console-performance.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-post-slimming-ui.unit.test.ts tests/features/v1-console.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-providers-ia-and-forms.unit.test.ts tests/features/console-ui-audit-confirmed-fixes.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/core-console-performance.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-post-slimming-ui.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/v1-console.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-providers-ia-and-forms.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/console-ui-audit-confirmed-fixes.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-12: All retained Console mutation forms intercept API failures so field errors render beside the matching input and operation errors stay in the current dialog. Provider relative timestamps use one server-supplied reference time and no longer hydrate with minute-boundary mismatches. Provider delete-race and Virtual Model duplicate-name real-process E2E pass.

features.evidence: 2026-07-11: One reproducible 24-table baseline, native accessible dialogs, strict parseArgs CLIs, four non-root compiled runtime images, deleted-surface guards, and enforced 45/45/38/50 coverage thresholds pass.
